cohort: Women delivering at term with a diagnosis of protracted second stage of labor
finding: While not statistically significant, there was a trend towards a lower rate of failed vacuum extraction and a lower cesarean section rate in the group who received intrapartum transperineal ultrasound.
mod_finding: Among women who had the addition of intrapartum ultrasound during the second stage of labor there was a trend toward a lower rate of failed vacuum extraction and a lower rate of cesarean section.
